Name: VITE_DATA_MODE
Purpose: Switches src/api from mock.ts to http.ts

Name: VITE_API_BASE_URL
Purpose: Base URL for every request (already ends in /v1)

Name: Authorization
Type / allowed values: Raw Cognito ID token, no "Bearer " prefix
Purpose: API Gateway's Cognito authorizer reads the ID token

Name: (missing field)
Purpose: The API omits fields that have no value

Name: code
Purpose: Machine-readable error code (see the error-code rows)

Name: message
Purpose: Show to the user exactly as written

Name: fileName
Purpose: Original file name; must end in .pdf or .docx

Name: fileSize
Purpose: Lets the API reject files over 10 MB before upload

Name: uploadKey
Purpose: Pass to POST /syllabi after the file is uploaded

Name: uploadUrl
Purpose: Presigned S3 URL; PUT the file here

Name: headers
Purpose: Send exactly these headers with the PUT (Content-Type)

Name: (file body)
Purpose: Upload straight to S3; use XHR progress events for the progress bar

Name: subject
Purpose: Subject area; used to find peer examples

Name: extractedText
Purpose: Show so faculty can confirm it was read correctly

Name: TOO_SHORT
Purpose: Almost no text found; likely a scanned PDF, suggest pasting

Name: UPLOAD_MISSING
Purpose: Uploaded file not found; upload again

Name: reviewRunning
Purpose: Disable both Run review buttons while true

Name: activeReviewId
Purpose: Resume polling with this review ID

Name: reviewId
Purpose: The review that created it (absent for v1)

Name: text
Purpose: Display, and DOCX download via src/lib/docx.ts

Name: EXPIRED
Purpose: Syllabus passed its 180 days; show the message

Name: reviewId
Purpose: Start a competency review; poll with this ID

Name: reviewId
Purpose: Start an AI review; poll with this ID

Name: REVIEW_RUNNING
Purpose: A review is already running on this syllabus

Name: (poll)
Purpose: Stop on COMPLETED or FAILED; after 5 minutes show "taking longer than expected"

Name: (updated syllabus)
Purpose: Working copy returns to the review's input version

Name: NOT_LATEST
Purpose: A newer version exists; only the latest review can be undone

Name: undoneAt
Purpose: Set if the review was undone

Name: results
Purpose: Present only when COMPLETED; see results rows

Name: changes
Purpose: What the rewrite changed and why

Name: diff
Purpose: Changes between input and output versions

Name: cephInterpretation
Purpose: CEPH's own interpretation text, quoted from KB1

Name: diff
Purpose: Changes between input and output versions

Name: target
Purpose: Week, module, or assignment it applies to

Name: peerExamples
Purpose: Citations from approved syllabi in KB2

Name: op
Purpose: Render inserts green, deletes struck through

Name: (updated syllabus)
Purpose: Submits the current version for admin approval

Name: FORBIDDEN
Purpose: Caller isn't in the admin group

Name: (updated syllabus)
Purpose: Copies the submitted version into KB2

Name: reason
Purpose: Shown to the faculty member as denyReason
